text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "Verified against core/models.py and notifications/sms.py. The finding's claim that a resent message should carry the same household_id, phone, template_id and params as the original is consistent with how queue_sms works (phone is taken from the household record, so it matches the original unless the household's phone changed)."}}
